careers.intro: Twenty job families and 28 roles at Barakah, with real responsibilities, qualifications, training paths and the body that licenses or authorises each one.
careers.toPlan: Plan a path to a role
careers.calloutBody: Each role carries a basis badge: Barakah-specific when ENEC or FANR describe it, Generic when it follows IAEA SSG-75, Uncertain when the Barakah structure is not public. No role names or pictures an incumbent, and pay and headcount are not shown.
careers.familiesDesc: {n} families, grouped as in the spec. Select a family to filter the roles.

compare.intro: Up to three roles side by side. Add or remove roles; the comparison is kept in the link so you can share it.
compare.max: You can compare up to three roles.
compare.needTwo: Choose at least two roles to compare
compare.oneChosen: {role} is selected. Add one or two more.

role.notFoundBody: There is no published role called "{slug}".
role.askQuestion: Tell me about the {role} role at Barakah
role.planTo: Plan a path to this role
role.securityBody: For security, safeguards and cyber roles Kafa'a shows the career path only. Training content, post orders and security arrangements are not published here.
role.entryRoutesDesc: Any one of these routes, each with its article reference.
role.eligibilityNote: General guidance only: eligibility is determined by ENEC and FANR.

role.noEdges: No progression edges recorded for this role yet
role.competenciesDesc: Development levels from the competency library (Awareness 1 to Expert 4).
role.standardsDesc: Qualification cards held by people in this role (authorisation layer, mirrored from the licensee's records).
role.noIncumbent: No role page names or pictures an incumbent. Every statement cites a source.

paths.intro: Four ways to read progression at Barakah: the licensed operator ladder, a hierarchy by level, a single family, and the full path graph.
paths.hierarchyDesc: Roles by family and level. Select a role to open it.
paths.familyEdges: Moves into and out of this family
paths.noFamilyEdges: No moves recorded for this family yet
paths.graphHint: Each box is a role; lines are recorded moves. Select a role to open it. The list below is the same graph as text.
paths.isolated: {n} roles have no recorded moves yet.

ladder.calloutBody: Entry requirements follow FANR-REG-17 Art. 4. Every route also needs a UAE security clearance, which Kafa'a records only as confirmed or pending.
ladder.title: Local Operator → Reactor Operator → Senior Reactor Operator → Shift Supervisor
ladder.desc: The condition on each step, as structured data.
ladder.loCondition: High-school diploma; DNT (24 months) or LOIT (60 weeks / 1,920 h); qualified by the licensee (REG-17 Art. 12)
ladder.w1: Certificate valid 5 years, renewable, for the named facility only (Art. 8)
ladder.w2: Medical within 6 months of certification, then every 12 months (Art. 10)
ladder.w3: Each quarter at least 7 eight-hour or 5 twelve-hour shifts; an SRO works at least 2 of them in the SRO role (Art. 11)
ladder.w4: Biennial requalification exam; COCT 5 to 6 weeks per crew per year
ladder.w5: A validity lapse is reported within 3 working days (Art. 13)
ladder.ssNote: The Shift Supervisor step is generic (IAEA SSG-75: 4 to 6 years' experience); the Barakah title and structure are unconfirmed.

plan.intro: Choose where you are and where you want to go. Kafa'a lists the recorded routes, the conditions on each step, an indicative minimum time and the competency gap.
plan.fromNone: Not in a role yet (entry routes)
plan.pickTargetBody: Pick any of the 28 roles. The planner works for the public too.
plan.reachable: Roles you can reach from here
plan.same: You are already in this role.
plan.noRouteBody: No progression edge links these roles yet. Talk to your manager or HR about a cross-functional move.
plan.gapDesc: {done} of {total} competencies already at the level the target role needs.
plan.noGap: No competency requirements recorded for the target role
plan.standardsTitle: Qualification cards in the target role
plan.standardsDesc: Completed through on-the-job training and task evaluations after you join the role.
plan.regulatedBody: Certification follows FANR-REG-17. Kafa'a gives general guidance; eligibility is determined by ENEC and FANR.
plan.disclaimer: Indicative only. Months are the minimum stated in the conditions; real timing depends on programmes, vacancies and the licensee's decisions.
plan.toIdp: Turn this into my development plan

planning.title: Planning assumption
planning.body: 2030 and 2035 profiles describe how this work may change so people can plan their learning. They are planning assumptions: no deployment decision is implied, and they say nothing about headcount or sites.

concept.about: What this concept role would do
concept.howDesc: Current roles with a "future" move to this concept role, with the indicative experience and bridge learning.
concept.profileDesc: The skills and competencies this concept role is expected to need, with the reason for each.

leadsTo.title: Concept roles this role can lead to
leadsTo.desc: Future moves for planning only: no vacancy and no deployment decision implied.

panel.pathOnlyBody: Security, safeguards and cyber roles are shown at career-path level only. Status is qualified or not qualified; requirements are not published here.

bench.borrow: What Kafa'a borrows from this benchmark:

careers.futureDesc: {n} concept roles linked to today's roles by future moves. No vacancy and no deployment decision implied.

paths.graphTitle: Future moves from current roles to concept roles
paths.listDesc: Each move lists indicative experience and the bridge learning it needs.

plan.skillsTitle: Skills this concept role asks for

overview.intro: How every role's requirements are expected to change by 2030 and 2035, and the concept roles today's roles can lead to. Counts are of roles, never of people.
overview.with2030Sub: Published; security roles at career-path level
overview.conceptsSub: At least 4 requirements and 1 inbound move each
overview.digitalChart: Roles asking for digital skills, by horizon
overview.aiChart: Roles asking for AI skills, by horizon
overview.mapDesc: Change score against the previous horizon: a new requirement counts its level, a raised one the increase.
overview.scoreNote: Security, safeguards and cyber roles are shown at career-path level only and carry no score.
overview.tableTitle: Every role across the three horizons
overview.conceptDesc: Each has a published profile and at least one future move from a current role.

method.title: How the profiles are built
method.s1: Estimate what each role will need at each horizon (the 2030 and 2035 profiles).
method.s2: Assess today's capability against the current profile (skills passport and readiness).
method.s3: Identify the gaps: new and raised requirements per role.
method.s4: Plan how to fill them: learning, moves and future roles, reviewed every year.

review.title: Drafts awaiting review
review.none: No drafts are open. {n} earlier versions are kept as history.

edit.title: Role profile: {role}
edit.intro: Edit the requirements for one horizon, check them, save a draft or publish. Publishing supersedes the previous version, is audited and is recorded in the NEXUS evidence ledger.
edit.pathOnly: This role stays at career-path level: requirements cannot be added. You can still update the rationale and sources.
edit.noHistory: No versions yet for this horizon.
edit.startsDraft: Saving starts a new draft from this version.
edit.okDraft: Ready to save as a draft.
edit.checksNote: The same rules run again on the server when you save.
edit.reqsDesc: Competencies and skills with a level from 1 to 4, an importance, an optional technology driver and a short reason in both languages.
edit.securityNote: Security-area skills and competencies are not offered: security content stays at career-path level.
edit.sourcesDesc: Publishing needs at least one https source.
edit.footer: Drafts are visible to training, admins and auditors only. Published versions are public.
edit.confirmBody: The new version becomes public and the previous one is kept as history. The action is audited and recorded in the NEXUS evidence ledger.

check.invalid: Choose a horizon, known drivers and a rationale of at least 20 characters in English and Arabic.
check.invalid_requirements: Each requirement needs a level from 1 to 4 and an importance; no duplicates; at most 30.
check.unknown_ref: A requirement points at an unknown competency or skill.
check.security_restricted: Security, safeguards and cyber content stays at career-path level.
check.unclean_text: Remove any mention of headcount, sites or a deployment decision.
check.source_required: Publishing needs at least one https source with a label.
check.too_few: A published profile needs requirements (a concept role at least 4).
